text.en: This Order may be cited as the Halal Certificate and Halal Label (Amendment) Order, 2012. of section 2 of S 39/05.

Section 2 of the Halal Certificate and Halal Label Order, 2005, in this Order referred to as the principal Order, is amended by inserting the following new definition immediately before the definition of "certificate" - means a person who makes an application under section 4(1) or 10{1);". of section 6.
Section 6 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "one year" and by substituting "3 years" therefor. of section 7.
Section 7 of the principal Order is amended, in subsection (2), by deleting "one year" and by substituting "3 years" therefor. of new section 42B.

The principal Order is amended by inserting the following new section immediately after section 42A - of notices. 42B. An applicant shall, if so directed by the Majlis, display such notices in such places, phrase them in such manner or cause them to be of such size, as may consider fit.". I of section 46.

The principal Order is amended by repealing the Fourth Schedule and by the following new Fourth Schedule therefor -

SCHEDULE and 46(1)) FEES Issue or renewal of Halal Certificate $90 Issue or replacement of Halal Certificate or permit $10 Issue of permit $50.". Made this 6th. day of Rabiulawal, 1433 Hijriah corresponding to the 30th. day of January, 2012 at Our Istana Nurul Iman, Bandar Seri Begawan, Brunei Darussalam.

THE SULTAN AND YANG DI-PERTUAN

BRUNEI DARUSSALAM Dicetak oleh PENGIRAN HAJI ZAINAL ABIDIN BIN PENGIRAN SERI WIJAYA PENGIRAN HAJI AHMAD, Pengarah Percetakan, di Jabatan Percetakan Kerajaan, Bandar Seri Begawan BB3510, Negara Brunei Darussalam.
